name: Shrimp Penne with Swiss Chard, Tomatoes, Mint, Pistachios & Parmesan

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds; cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain pasta and set aside. (Reserve a ½-cup pasta water before draining.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
425 g penne pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small pkg fresh mint
1 ½ lemons
3 bunches Swiss chard
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a small bowl.
Zest and juice lemons into the bowl with the mint.
Finely grate Parmesan. Add half to the bowl, stir to combine, and set aside. (Reserve remaining Parmesan for serving.)

Fold chard leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips and thinly slice the stems, keeping them separate. Place leaves in a large bowl and stems in a medium bowl. Set leaves aside for later use.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the chard stems.
Preheat another large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chard stems, tomatoes, salt, and pepper to the pot; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, if using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 1.02 kg raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: When the tomatoes have softened, add shrimp to the pot; cook, stirring occasionally, until shrimp are cooked through, 3-4 minutes.
While the shrimp are cooking, roughly chop pistachios.

Add chard leaves to the pot in handfuls, waiting for them to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Add drained pasta, reserved pasta water, pistachios, and the Parmesan mixture. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until pasta is combined and coated in sauce, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls and sprinkle with reserved Parmesan. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
